cli.flags_help:
--remote / -r  Remote TLS target (repeatable)
  --local / -l  Local certificate or private-key file (repeatable)
  --password-file  Password file INDEX=PATH (repeatable; zero-based input index)
  --ask-password  Read a hidden password for INDEX (repeatable; terminal required)
  --targets-file  Remote target list (repeatable; expanded occurrence indices start at 0)
  --compare-cert  Candidate certificate INDEX=PATH (repeatable; expanded input index)
  --connect-ip  Per-target dial IP INDEX=IP (repeatable; expanded input index; verification identity is unchanged)
  --concurrency  Remote concurrency: 1–32 (default 1; reports keep input order)
  --language / -L  Language: en | zh-TW | zh-CN
  --format / -f  Report: table | json | html | markdown (default table)
  --detail  Table detail: summary | full (default summary; table only)
  --output / -o  Report path, or - for stdout (default -)
  --timeout / -t  Per-target total timeout: 1ms–5m (default 10s)
  --expiry-warning-days  Expiry warning days: 0–36500 (default 30; 0 disables warnings)
  --fail-on-expiry-warning  Treat expiry warnings as verification failures (exit 1; uses --expiry-warning-days)
  --overwrite  Allow replacing an existing report; requires --output PATH
  --settings / -s  Interactive language and theme settings
  --help / -h  Show help
  --version / -V  Show version
  --  Treat all remaining tokens as positional inputs
cli.syntax_help: Multiple inputs may repeat -r/--remote or -l/--local; --targets-file, --connect-ip, --compare-cert, --password-file and --ask-password are also repeatable. Other flags may appear once. Help/version only allow language; settings is standalone. Menu help: --settings --help.
